name: GD Control
description: A Geometry Dash-styled mod menu with No-Clip and Speedhack.

noclip-enabled.name: No-Clip
noclip-enabled.description: Suppresses normal player deaths. Anticheat spikes and level completion still use the game's normal path.

speed-multiplier.name: Speedhack
speed-multiplier.description: Scales gameplay-layer updates without changing the global Cocos scheduler.
